raw.title: Technischer Senior Projektmanager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Dein Plus bei der vitagroup

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Mobile Office
  • Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im europäischen Ausland
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Auslandskrankenversicherung
  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, Sozialleistungen und einen leistungsabhängigen Bonus
  • JobRad: Fahrrad-Leasing zur beruflichen und privaten Nutzung
  • Attraktive MitarbeiterInnen-Rabatte
  • Offene Feedback-Kultur und individuelle Weiterbildung
  • Interdisziplinäre Aufgaben
  • Agile & digitale Unternehmensstrukturen
  • Über 20 Jahre Wissen & Erfahrung in der digitalen Gesundheitswelt
  • Mentoring & Wissensaustausch


Dafür brauchen wir Dich

  • Du übernimmst die technische Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte von der Planung bis zur Fertigstellung und erarbeitest eigenständig erste Vorschläge zur Zielarchitektur und zum Schnittstellendesign
  • Du arbeitest nah am Kunden-remote und vor Ort-und verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Team den Weg von der Anforderung bis zum produktiven Betrieb
  • Du förderst die Zusammenarbeit mit operativen und technischen Kundenvertretern, um Produktakzeptanz und Systemintegration zu verbessern
  • Du fungierst intern als Sprachrohr des Kunden-im engen Austausch mit Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, Entwicklung und Support
  • Du übersetzt klinische Prozesse und fachliche Anforderungen in technische Schnittstellen- und Integrationskonzepte (u.a. HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR,openEHR, DICOM)
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Solution Architects und Technical Consultants im Team zusammen und unterstützt mit belastbaren technischen Konzepten (PoCs, Referenzlösungen)
  • Du übernimmst je nach Projektphase auch angrenzende Rollen im Team – etwa in der technischen Beratung, im Anforderungsmanagement oder in der Presales-Unterstützung
  • Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Stakeholdern Projektumfang, Ziele, Anforderungen und die zu erbringenden Leistungen
  • Du verantwortest Projektbudgets, Zeitpläne und Ressourcen sowie das Projektcontrolling und die Berichterstattung
  • Du steuerst Datenintegrationsprojekte und stellst eine reibungslose Verbindung zwischen den beteiligten Systemen sicher
  • Du identifizierst Projektrisiken, entwickelst geeignete Maßnahmen zur Risikominimierung und stellst den Projekterfolg sicher
  • Du koordinierst die Kommunikation zwischen technischen und nicht-technischen Beteiligten und informierst alle Stakeholder über den Projektfortschritt 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Gesundheitswesen mit, idealerweise im Krankenhausumfeld, davon einen wesentlichen Anteil in einer technischen Projektmanagement-, Solution-Delivery- oder vergleichbar technisch geprägten Funktion
  • Du verfügst mindestens über einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Medizininformatik, eHealth oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von Gesundheitstechnologien sowie in der Steuerung komplexer Schnittstellen- und Datenintegrationsprojekte im klinischen Umfeld
  • Du besitzt praktische Erfahrung mit klinischen Prozessen, IT-Architekturen und Systemen wie HIS, RIS, PACS und ERP sowie mit Standards wie HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR, DICOM und idealerweise openEHR
  • Du hast idealerweise Vorerfahrung als Solution Consultant oder im technischen Presales, kannst Anforderungen technisch lesen und kommunizierst mit Architekt:innen und Entwickler:innen auf Augenhöhe
  • Du bringst die Flexibilität mit, in wechselnden Rollen und Projektkontexten zu arbeiten, und stellst Dich schnell auf neue Kunden, Themen und Technologien ein
  • Du bist bereit, für Kundeneinsätze projektabhängig zu reisen – überwiegend im deutschsprachigen Raum
  • Du arbeitest routiniert cross-funktional mit anderen Fachbereichen
  • Du kommunizierst präzise, freundlich und serviceorientiert und überzeugst durch eine hohe Kundenorientierung
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, lösungs- und geschäftsorientiert und verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Selbstorganisation
  • Du bist in der Lage, mehrere Projekte parallel zu steuern und nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch

title: Werkstudent EV Sales & Deal Operations (m/w/d)
description: Über Aampere Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen es EV-Besitzer:innen, ihr Fahrzeug innerhalb von 48 Stunden zu verkaufen, und verschaffen Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundensegmenten. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, intransparent und schwer vertrauenswürdig, deshalb bauen wir die Infrastruktur, die das ändert, damit mehr Elektroautos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Wandel zur Elektromobilität wirklich an Fahrt aufnimmt. Und es funktioniert: Wir steigern unseren Umsatz Jahr für Jahr um das Vierfache und halten bereits mehr als 1 % des deutschen Consumer-EV-Wiederverkaufsmarkts. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG. Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams. Deine Mission Du hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform. Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft. Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten. Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen. Das bringst du mit Dein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse. Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl. Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten. Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr. Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift. Why Aampere? Wachstum & Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle. Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats) Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next? Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. Chance auf Übernahme : Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte. Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn... ...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. ...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten. ...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren. ...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt. ...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen. Wie wir arbeiten Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen: Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun. Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen. Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion. Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam. Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht. raw.description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. 


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.

title: Senior Manager, Velocity Account Executives, EMEA
description: Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. Sonatype is accelerating the future of agentic software development. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. Our Nexus One platform helps development, security, and platform teams govern the components, dependencies, models, and artifacts that power modern applications without slowing innovation down. We are uniquely positioned to lead this next era. Sonatype operates both Maven Central, one of the world’s largest public open source registries, and Nexus Repository, a top-ranked enterprise repository used by thousands of organizations and over 70% of the Fortune 100. With over 1 trillion downloads annually across our ecosystem, we have unmatched visibility into how software is published, consumed, and propagated. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence. We are looking for people who want to build. People who are scrappy, entrepreneurial, hands-on, and hungry to make an impact. Sonatype is at an exciting inflection point, and we need teammates who can see the opportunity ahead, move with urgency, and help us shape the way the world builds secure software in the AI era. As the Senior Manager, Velocity Account Executives at Sonatype, you will lead, coach, and scale a high-velocity team of 6 to 8 full-cycle Territory Account Executives (TAEs). This team operates at the frontline of Sonatype’s Go-To-Market transition, moving from historical inbound dependency toward a proactive, high-volume outbound hunting engine where each AE is responsible for their own pipeline creation. Managing sub-$50k deal sizes, your team is expected to drive transaction velocity, closing 50+ deals per account executive annually. In alignment with Sonatype’s Employee Value Proposition, we are seeking a leader of "Future Builders", someone who leverages continuous experimentation, outbound rigor, and AI-amplified workflows to drive unprecedented commercial velocity. You will instill a relentless hunting culture focused on taking market share, leveraging our preventative Sonatype Firewall as the primary commercial wedge to capture new logos quickly and build a foundational installed base for future enterprise expansion. ROLE OUTCOMES: Within your first 12 months in this role, you will be expected to deliver on the following concrete value metrics: High-Velocity Deal Execution: Drive team performance to consistently achieve and exceed team targets of 50+ closed deals per AE per year (sub-$50k deal category), ensuring predictable quarterly pipeline conversion and run-rate revenue. Outbound Pipeline Expansion: Transition the territory team to an outbound hunting motion, generating at least 60% of new sales pipeline through outbound prospecting, targeted account plays, and full-funnel prospecting and lead generation. New Logo Acquisition & Wedge Growth: Accelerate new enterprise customer acquisition across assigned territories, utilizing Sonatype Firewall as a fast-onboarding wedge product to achieve >100% YoY growth in velocity logo additions. AI & Process Optimization: Automate and redesign sales workflows using AI tools and modern sales tech, reducing deal cycle times by 15-20% and maximizing AE active selling time. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES: Sales Team Leadership & Execution: Direct, inspect, and coach a high-performing team of 6–8 Territory Account Executives handling velocity sales cycles (sub-$50k transaction size). Hunting & Outbound Rigor: Enforce a disciplined, proactive outbound cadence. Teach AEs how to map accounts, identify target personas (VP of Engineering and CISO), and drive cold-to-close pipeline. This team is entirely self-sufficient, owning the end-to-end sales process from initial outreach to closed-won deal, with no BDR/SDR support. Work Redesign & Process Automation: Act as a "Work Designer" by continually evaluating the AE workflow. Implement AI-driven prospecting, automated outreach tools, and streamlined CRM practices to eliminate sales friction and eliminate non-value-add activity. Cross-Functional Trade-offs & Alignment: Partner Field Marketing, and Revenue Operations to execute targeted account-based growth programs. Optimize resource allocation for Sonatype rather than strictly defending departmental silos. Pipeline Forecasting & Performance Management: Maintain operational rigor across pipeline inspection, activity tracking, and accurate weekly forecasting using standard sales methodologies. Talent Development & Coaching: Conduct daily/weekly deal reviews, call shadowing, and active coaching to build the next generation of sales leaders within Sonatype. YOU: Sales Leadership Experience: 3+ years of direct sales management experience leading high-velocity inside sales or territory account executive teams within SaaS, DevOps, or Cybersecurity industries. Proven Track Record: Demonstrated history of managing teams through high transaction volume environments (50+ deals/AE/year) with sub-$50k average deal sizes. Outbound Hunting Mastery: Deep expertise in building and executing account-based outbound prospecting frameworks; proven ability to transition teams from inbound-reliant to outbound-driven. Commercial Methodology & Stack: Hands-on experience with modern sales stacks (Salesforce, Outreach/Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, AI prospecting tools) and structured value selling methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message). An additional language skill is hugely beneficial, ideally German. Things that we are proud of: 2025 AI Compliance Solution of the Year - AI Breakthrough Awards 2025 DEVIES Award to our SBOM Manager new product for its innovation and impact in developer technology 2024 Industry Leader in Forrester-Wave for Software Composition Analysis (2024 Q4 report) 2023 Fast Company Best Places for Innovators 2023 Gartner’s Magic Quadrant 2023 Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies 2023 BuiltIn Best Places to Work 2022 Frost & Sullivan Technology Innovation Leader Award 2022 PeerSpot Silver Peer Award in Software Composition Analysis 2022 Tech Ascension Best DevOps Security Solution Award 2022 NVCT Cyber Company of the Year Company Wellness Week - We shut down company operations for a week to enable all employees to pursue personal growth and enjoy a much-needed and deserved rest.Paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) At Sonatype, we value diversity and inclusivity. We offer perks such as parental leave, diversity and inclusion working groups, and flexible working practices to allow our employees to show up as their whole selves. We are an equal-opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. title: Juriste Stagiaire (PPI, Stage M2) - Droit Commercial
description:
En bref

Tu as envie de contribuer à la révolution des supermarchés ? Chez Picnic, tu as l'opportunité de rejoindre une jeune équipe créative et bouillonnante, dans une culture start-up, où tout ce que tu fais compte. Grâce à une approche basée sur les données (data-driven) et un service unique, Picnic se bat pour faire des courses quelque chose de simple, drôle et accessible à tous. En outre, nous travaillons dans la perspective d'un avenir plus durable en utilisant des technologies de pointe et en exploitant une flotte de véhicules de livraison 100 % électriques.

En 2021, Picnic a levé 600 millions d'euros auprès de la Fondation Bill & Melinda Gates afin de se développer en Europe. Après avoir lancé avec succès les opérations en Allemagne et dans le Nord de la France, nous poursuivons maintenant notre expansion en France en nous développant notamment en région parisienne.

Tes missions

Basé.e au bureau de Paris, tu feras partie de l'équipe juridique et travailleras avec le directeur juridique France, en étroite coopération avec l'équipe des Pays-Bas et les équipes opérationnelles en France. Concrètement, tes missions seront principalement :

  • Contrats commerciaux : gestion des contrats quotidiens (les revoir et commenter, les négocier avec l'aide d'un responsable juridique, et les suivre jusqu'à la signature) ;
  • Baux commerciaux : revoir les lettres d'offres et travailler sur les premiers drafts des baux, assurer le suivi du process jusqu'à la signature ;
  • Être le premier interlocuteur des équipes opérationnelles, notamment des équipes commerciales, safety et infrastructure, pour toutes leurs questions juridiques ;
  • Assister l'équipe juridique sur les projets de long-terme (pré-contentieux/contentieux) et les négociations de contrats complexes ; et
  • Gestion du secrétariat juridique et des formations (augmentations de capital, approbation des comptes, gestion des pages permettant la formation des opérationnels, etc.).

À propos de toi

  • Élève-avocat.e (PPI) ou Master 2 en droit avec une connaissance générale du droit français des affaires (droit privé, contrats, consommation, distribution, immobilier, etc.)
  • Tu es vif.ve, dynamique, autonome et rigoureux.se, tu as l'esprit d'équipe et es force de propositions
  • Anglais professionnel, qui te permet de suivre des réunions, de communiquer et de lire et écrire parfaitement (l'anglais est la langue de travail de Picnic)
  • Tu cherches un stage à partir de janvier 2027
  • Tu vis déjà ou as la possibilité de te relocaliser à Paris

Avantages Picnic

Tout expert a un jour été débutant ! Tu auras de nombreuses occasions de te mettre au défi et de t'épanouir, notamment grâce aux sessions Lunch & Learn et à la formation sur mesure en compétences non techniques. Nous proposons également des cours de langue professionnels hebdomadaires gratuits.

Fais la différence. Tu travailleras dans un environnement stimulant, avec la liberté de mener tes propres projets et de créer un impact direct et visible. Grâce à nos véhicules entièrement électriques et à notre modèle économique durable, tu contribueras également à rendre le monde meilleur !

Le travail d'équipe nous fait avancer ! Avec plus de 80 nationalités réparties dans 3 pays, tu feras partie d'une entreprise diversifiée qui offre de nombreuses occasions de s'investir, qu'il s'agisse de soirées à thème, d'apéritifs entre collègues ou de nos séjours annuels au ski, etc.

Reste en bonne santé. La santé mentale est importante. En plus de la possibilité de parler avec des collègues qui agissent en tant que conseiller(ère)s confidentiel(le)s, notre collaboration avec OpenUp te donne un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, ainsi qu'à des ateliers et des outils pratiques. Il existe de nombreuses communautés et événements sportifs auxquels tu peux participer, du tennis au yoga en passant par l'escalade !

Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée. Dans la mesure du possible, nous souhaitons te permettre de travailler selon des modalités adaptées à ton style de travail, ce qui explique notre modèle de travail hybride. Nos équipes aiment généralement avoir au moins un jour en équipe par semaine au bureau, mais à part cela, c'est toi et ton équipe qui décidez.

Notre offre : Pour ce stage de 6 mois, nous offrons un salaire brut de 1500,00 € par mois. 

 

Merci de soumettre ta candidature (CV et une lettre de motivation) en anglais.

title: CDI - Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist - Strat Data - Paris
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?


Artefact est un cabinet de conseil international spécialisé en Data et Intelligence Artificielle, présent dans plus de 20 pays avec plus de 2 500 collaborateurs.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans leur transformation en combinant expertise technologique, conseil et connaissance métier, sur des enjeux allant de la stratégie Data & IA à la conception et au déploiement de solutions concrètes.

Nos équipes réunissent notamment des Business Consultants, Data Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers, qui interviennent auprès de grands groupes internationaux dans des secteurs variés.

Notre ambition : mettre la Data et l’IA au service de problématiques business concrètes et créer un impact mesurable pour nos clients.

Ton rôle

Au sein de l’équipe Talent Acquisition France et sous la responsabilité de la Head of Talent Acquisition, tu pilotes en autonomie le recrutement des équipes Strat Data d’Artefact, sur des profils allant de Junior à Manager.

Partenaire des équipes opérationnelles, tu les accompagnes tout au long du processus afin de garantir des recrutements de qualité et une expérience candidat exigeante :

Piloter les recrutements de bout en bout

  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins auprès des managers
  • Définir et mettre en œuvre l’approche de recrutement adaptée à chaque besoin
  • Piloter l’ensemble du processus : sourcing, qualification, entretiens RH, coordination des étapes d’évaluation et offre
  • Développer une approche proactive du sourcing et constituer des viviers de profils pertinents.

Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles

  • Conseiller et challenger les managers tout au long du processus afin de garantir des décisions de recrutement objectives et cohérentes
  • Garantir la bonne application du processus et des méthodes d’évaluation
  • Veiller à une expérience de recrutement de qualité pour les candidatures et les équipes internes

Contribuer à l’amélioration continue

  • Identifier les points de friction et contribuer à l’amélioration des processus et pratiques
  • Veiller à la qualité et à la fiabilité des données dans notre ATS (Greenhouse)
  • Contribuer aux projets et initiatives de l’équipe Talent Acquisition.

Ton profil

  • Une expérience confirmée en recrutement, idéalement dans le conseil/ ESN
  • Une maîtrise du recrutement de bout en bout, avec une solide pratique du sourcing et de l’approche directe
  • Une capacité à gérer et prioriser un périmètre de recrutement en autonomie
  • Une posture de business partner, avec la capacité de conseiller et challenger
  • Une bonne maîtrise des outils de recrutement et un bon niveau d’anglais.

Rémunération : jusqu’à 44K annuel selon profil.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Formations continues et participation à des projets stratégiques d'acquisition et de fidélisation des talents
  • Équipe dynamique, flexibilité télétravail, séminaires d'équipe
  • Localisation Paris 9ème

Étapes du recrutement

  1. Entretien avec Mélody, Head of Talent Acquisition
  2. Entretien avec Laurie, DRH

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte, notamment de croyances, de genre, d’âge, de situation d'handicap, d’origine ethnique, d’orientation sexuelle, d’appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité.

title: L3 Support Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role 

We are building our L3 Support Line from scratch to serve as the datacenter center of expertise for servers, firmware (BIOS/BMC), and deep Linux diagnostics across Europe and the US.

This is a senior technical role focused on deep investigations, cross-site pattern detection, and driving permanent fixes with R&D and ODM vendors. You will turn complex incidents into scalable solutions and elevate L1/L2 capabilities through strong technical enablement.

The work location is in Béthune, France. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

Deep Technical Investigation (Primary Focus)

  • Lead root cause analysis beyond L2 depth (GPU failures, firmware issues, Linux-level faults, HW/SW interactions).

  • Detect recurring patterns across sites and convert findings into durable fixes.

  • Own technical workstreams during high-severity incidents.

Vendor & R&D Collaboration

  • Build evidence packs and drive escalations with ODM and R&D.

  • Push for firmware, component, and platform-level resolutions.

  • Track outcomes and ensure knowledge flows back to operations.

Firmware & Platform Readiness (BIOS/BMC)

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris. Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée. Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage. Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM. À propos du projet PLEIADES Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM. Vos principales missions seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026 Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois Description de poste ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.   • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial

You lead and define technical strategies, demonstrating a strong understanding of system design to solve complex, impactful problems. You are comfortable leading the development of complex projects affecting multiple teams and domains , driving initiatives from ideation to completion. title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit. The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture. The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale. In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit. Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase. Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code. Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches. Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards. Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases. In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites. Must Haves: 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python. Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar). Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake). Understanding of distributed architecture. Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP , TCP, IP) and POSIX standards. Experience in developing multi-threaded applications. Previous team leader or manager role Nice to Haves: Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust. Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms. title: Business Analytics Architect
description:
Muck Rack is the leading SaaS platform for public relations and communications professionals. Our mission is to enable organizations to build trust, tell their stories, and demonstrate the unique value of earned media. Muck Rack’s AI-powered, comprehensive, and integrated platform streamlines the PR workflow to help businesses generate positive media coverage, monitor mentions to manage brand reputation, and analyze PR’s impact on business outcomes. By combining media database, monitoring, and reporting into one dynamic platform, we empower teams to collaborate seamlessly, pitch effectively, and analyze results faster and more efficiently.

Founder-controlled, fully distributed, and growing sustainably, Muck Rack has received several awards for its unparalleled culture and product from organizations like Inc., Quartz, G2, and BuiltIn. We value resilience, transparency, ownership, and customer devotion, and infuse these values into everything we do. 

We’re looking for a collaborative, self-motivated Analytics Architect to join our Business Data Analytics team.

Reporting to the VP, Analytics, you’ll serve as the lead architect for Business Data Analytics, defining and driving an AI-first data and analytics architecture that modernizes our analytics platform and enables new ways for teams to access and interact with data.

You’ll establish the technical blueprint for a modern data analytics stack supporting Data Ingestion to Snowflake / Databricks, Data Modeling / Semantic Layers (dbt, Python, SQL), Natural Language Analytics (Agents), Data Activation (rETL, System to System), and Self-Service Analytics (BI Tools). You’ll collaborate across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Revenue Operations to establish scalable architecture, integration patterns, governance, and engineering practices that enable trusted data and AI-powered analyticsacross the business.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and drive the target architecture for an AI-first enterprise data and analytics platform, establishing the technical direction and patterns needed to modernize and consolidate the analytics technology stack
  • Architect scalable data infrastructure, ingestion and transformation frameworks, storage models, and integration patterns across Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Python, SQL, and related systems
  • Design governed semantic data layers and the supporting architecture for AI agents, natural language querying, conversational analytics, and other AI-powered data experiences
  • Establish architecture patterns for retrieval, APIs, and integrations that allow AI agents and applications to securely discover, understand, and interact with trusted enterprise data
  • Lead the evolution of data governance, security, privacy, access control, and compliance patterns across the analytics stack, balancing accessibility with appropriate safeguards
  • Establish and champion engineering standards for data modeling, testing, observability, CI/CD, documentation, deployment, and system integration, improving the reliability and maintainability of the analytics platform
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Analytics Engineers on the team

To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You’ll Need to Have

  • 7+ years of experience designing and evolving modern data and analytics architectures, including responsibility for architectural decisions that span multiple systems, teams, or business use cases
  • Deep experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics engineering practices, including Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Python, and SQL
  • Experience designing scalable data models, transformation pipelines, semantic or metrics layers, and integration patterns that enable trusted self-service analytics
  • Experience architecting or implementing AI-enabled data systems, such as natural language analytics, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, or related LLM-powered data workflows
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise data governance, security, privacy, access control, and data quality practices, with experience translating those requirements into practical technical architecture
  • Experience establishing engineering practices such as automated testing, CI/CD, observability, version control, and reliable deployment patterns for data and analytics systems
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, evaluate complex architectural trade-offs, and influence decisions across teams without relying on direct authority
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data and AI architecture into clear decisions, standards, and technical direction for both technical and business partners

If Any of the Below Also Describe You, This Could Be an Exciting Opportunity

  • You’ve helped modernize or consolidate a fragmented enterprise data ecosystem into a more cohesive modern data stack
  • You’ve designed semantic or metrics layers specifically to support AI-powered, conversational, or self-service analytics
  • You have experience taking AI agents or RAG-based data applications from architecture through production implementation
  • You’ve developed reusable frameworks, standards, or platform capabilities that increased the effectiveness of analytics and engineering teams
  • You enjoy mentoring engineers and raising technical standards while remaining an individual contributor
  • You’re comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments where the architecture is still being defined and your decisions will influence how teams build for years to come

In Addition, We’re Always Looking for Candidates Who

  • Approach architecture pragmatically, balancing immediate business needs with scalability, maintainability, security, and long-term platform health
  • Build alignment across technical and non-technical teams and communicate architectural decisions and trade-offs clearly
  • Take ownership of ambiguous, complex problems and create clarity and actionable technical direction
  • Look for opportunities to create reusable systems, standards, and patterns that increase the effectiveness of other teams
  • Share knowledge generously and mentor teammates through complex technical and architectural challenges
  • Proactively incorporate AI tools into day-to-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery

Interview Overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  • 30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team
  • A 1 hour zoom interview with the hiring manager
  • Peer interviews with several team members
  • Skills Assessment
  • Executive interviews
  • 30-minute Bar Raiser

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary

  • The anticipated salary for this role in United Kingdom is £130,000–£150,000, depending on experience.

If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Remote Work, Forever 

  • Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup
  • Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership

Precision for Medicine are recruiting a Regulatory Manager / Senior Regulatory Manager (depending on experience) to join our growing global team.

As a Regulatory Manager, you will provide regulatory strategy and development guidance for optimal conduct of clinical trials, regulatory agency meetings, orphan designations, paediatric planning, and accelerated procedures, ensuring timely preparation of well organised, quality regulatory submissions in compliance with applicable regulations. You will be responsible for coordinating and preparing regulatory documents for submission to Regulatory Authorities and/or Ethics Committees, as applicable. 

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Provides regulatory guidance throughout the clinical development life cycle
  • Compile, coordinate and review applications to Regulatory Authorities including, but not limited to, CTA/IND, annual reports, routine amendments, scientific advice/regulatory authority meetings, orphan designations, paediatric planning, and marketing applications. Also provides strategic regulatory input as required
  • Develops and/or reviews documents intended for submission to the Regulatory Authorities and/or Ethics Committees to assure compliance with regulatory standards
  • Serve as representative of Global Regulatory Affairs at project team meetings with both external and internal customers
  • Works within a project team, and where necessary, leads project for the region or globally
  • Oversee and coordinate Regulatory Affairs Specialists to achieve submission targets for contracted programs
  • Maintenance of project plans, project trackers and regulatory intelligence tools as it pertains to assigned responsibilities and to keep Regulatory Leadership updated.
  • Assist in development of Regulatory Affairs Specialists and other operational area staff, as required
  • Provide input, as required, into regulatory strategy and timeline development for new study opportunities Assists in establishing company standards to ensure the highest quality of submitted information
  • Participates in maintaining and executing on the corporate quality initiatives across business units within clinical solutions.
  • Keeps abreast and continually expand knowledge of laws, regulations and guidelines governing drug development and approval
  • Provides ICH GCP guidance, advice and training to internal and external clients
  • Serve as representative of Global Regulatory Affairs at business development meetings

The ideal candidate will have the following:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelors degree, or equivalent experience, ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline
  • 5 years Regulatory experience required for the Manager level and 7 years Regulatory experience required for the Senior Manager Regulatory level
  • Informed knowledge of all aspects of the drug development process inclusive of regulatory milestones and specialised knowledge of regulatory activities for at least one major region (EU, US) including but not limited to submissions to Regulatory Authorities, including INDs/CTAs and amendments, Scientific Advice Procedures, and post-approval submissions.

    • Ability to understand clinical and pre-clinical study results, to help in its interpretation for regulatory positions and strategy
    • Knowledgeable of clinical trials methodology, including a working knowledge of protocols and indications being studied
    • Knowledge and expertise with relevant regulations and guidance supporting pharmaceutical development
    • Availability for domestic and international travel including overnight stays

Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to contribute to a team environment involving balancing the demands stemming from multifaceted research activities
  • Understanding of financial management

We are expanding our amazing sales team in the UK and looking for rising stars to build that team with us.  This is a unique opportunity to take a proven and scalable business model and further roll it out in the UK. 

Our award winning technology stack, rock solid fulfillment operations and ShipBob brand name will help generate leads.  We are looking for Account Executives willing to work in a start-up environment, be self-driven, identify exciting new customers and work autonomously in a frictionless environment to reach the rewarding quota. 

As one of the early joiners in a high growth organization and in a high growth market there will be opportunities to grow with ShipBob. Your primary targets are medium-sized ecommerce merchants looking for world-class fulfillment and great technology.  With short sales cycles and implementation time, we make it easy for new clients to start fulfilling with ShipBob and for you to reach your goals. 

You will manage a sales pipeline and continue to prospect opportunities to bring on new customer revenue for the business. This role reports to the Manager, Client Acquisition.

  • Bring in new business to attain revenue targets using self-sourcing techniques.

  • Move customers efficiently through the sales process, ensuring all expectations are properly set and understood.

  • Have a thorough understanding of both our tech offerings and Operational capabilities. 
  • Maintain an updated, clean and thorough pipeline to ensure proper forecasting as well as up to date CRM notes so account status is clear. 
  • Give feedback to management to continue to improve the sales process and Merchant experience. 
  • Ensure proper handoff to the post sales team. 
  • Identify local nuances and help improve processes, tools and documentation. 
  • Additional duties and responsibilities as necessary.

  • At least 18 months as an Account Executive or Sales Representative in the eCommerce fulfillment or OMS/WMS/TMS tech space. 
  • Ability to foster great teamwork and motivate those around you. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Organization and time management skills. 
  • Established track record of success in a Sales position. 
  • Ability to understand client needs and handle the negotiation process. 
  • Computer skills, especially MS Excel and CRM software.

  • Medical and Wellness Benefits 
  • Life Assurance 
  • Income Protection 
  • Pension Scheme 
  • See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob)

Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. 

About You: 

Building the world’s leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob’s environment isn’t the right fit for everyone, and that’s okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you.

ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob’s proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob’s dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. description: Please note that this is a hybrid position based in Brighton, requiring 3 days onsite each week, with the option for remote work on the remaining days. Part of the Rocket Science Group, Atomic Theory comprises a multinational team of seasoned AAA veterans with roots extending from Blizzard, PUBG, Epic, and Unity. We have a track record of delivering player-centric, AAA-quality experiences, and we're unwavering in our commitment to performance, accessibility, and the meticulous attention to the engineering tools and frameworks that underpin exceptional gameplay. But Atomic Theory is also more than just a studio; for us, it's a sanctuary, a place where our diverse experiences can intersect and combine to carry our solutions to the next level. We're dedicated to aiding studios and publishers in navigating the toughest challenges across today's game development landscape -- and with offices in Albany NY, Brighton UK and Cardiff UK, we thrive at the opportunity to Get Sh!t Done on a global scale. Our passion for gaming is at the core of everything we do, inspiring us to collaborate seamlessly. We're not afraid to take on big challenges and push for bold, innovative solutions. Every decision we make is guided by the goal of delivering maximum value and creating a significant, positive impact on our projects. By consistently going above and beyond, we transform every interaction into an exceptional partnership, building trust and delivering excellence. ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a Principal Game Engineer to join our growing co-dev team. In this role, you will take ownership of the systems players feel most directly: gameplay, UI, 3Cs (character, camera, and controls), and AI. Working across a variety of partner projects, you will design, implement, and refine the systems that drive the moment-to-moment experience, bringing expert engineering judgement to everything from input handling and camera behaviour to UI architecture and core gameplay systems. As a principal engineer, you will set the technical direction in your area, act as a trusted, customer-facing point of contact for our partners, and raise the bar for quality across the wider team. An ideal candidate is passionate about games, has deep experience building player-facing systems in Unreal Engine (or similar), combines expert C++ and C# skills with strong 3D maths, and has a track record of delivering polished, responsive player systems and experiences. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Player Experience Development: Design, implement, and polish gameplay features, UI systems, and 3Cs (character, camera, and controls) that feel responsive, intuitive, and satisfying in players' hands. Technical Leadership: Own the technical direction for player experience work across projects, making sound architectural decisions, anticipating risks, and guiding solutions from prototype through to ship quality. Customer-Facing Collaboration: Act as a senior technical representative to our partners, gathering requirements, presenting solutions, communicating trade-offs clearly, and building the trust that underpins great co-development relationships. Critical Problem Solving: Apply strong analytical and debugging skills, including profiling and diagnostic tools, to investigate and resolve complex technical issues across gameplay, UI, and engine-level systems. Mentorship: Support and mentor engineers across the team, sharing expertise in player experience engineering and helping to grow the studio's capabilities in gameplay, UI, and 3Cs. Code Review: Champion high standards of code quality, performance, and maintainability through code reviews, constructive feedback, and by setting the example in your own work. WHAT WE VALUE: Expert Software Engineering: Extensive professional experience developing and shipping games, with the depth of judgement expected at a principal level and a history of delivering high-quality, player-facing systems. Strong C++ and C# Skills: Expert proficiency in C++ and C#, with a commitment to writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Strong 3D Maths: A firm grasp of the linear algebra and geometry that underpin cameras, character movement, animation, and gameplay systems. Unreal Engine Skills: Deep experience developing player-facing systems in Unreal Engine, including the Gameplay Framework, UMG/Slate, and input and camera systems. Unreal experience is preferred, though we also value strong Unity backgrounds. Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills and a proactive, methodical approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving technical challenges. Customer-Facing Communication: Confidence and clarity when working directly with partners and stakeholders, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to varied audiences. Player Focus: An instinct for what makes games feel great, and the craft to translate that instinct into responsive controls, readable UI, and satisfying gameplay. Team Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with engineers, designers, artists, producers, and project leads. Passion for Gaming: A genuine enthusiasm for games and a desire to help create engaging, high-quality experiences for players. WHAT YOU MAY ALSO HAVE: Console Experience: Experience shipping titles on current-generation consoles such as PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, or Switch 2. Unity Experience: Professional experience developing and shipping games in Unity alongside your Unreal background. Advanced Unreal Experience: Familiarity with custom engine modifications, plugin development, the Gameplay Ability System, or working from Unreal Engine source. Accessibility Knowledge: Experience designing and implementing accessible controls, UI, and player options. Co-Development Experience: Prior experience in a co-dev, outsourcing, or external development environment working with multiple partners and codebases. WHAT WE CAN OFFER: Competitive Salary and Benefits Package: Your health and wellbeing is important to us, so we offer a variety of benefits including: Hybrid Working Arrangement: Our office in Brighton is located centrally. As a member of our team, you’ll have the flexibility to work at home and collaborate with your fellow team members in person. Private Pension via Salary Sacrifice Optional Private Medical , Dental , and Vision coverage Annual Leave , plus Bank Holidays and Winter Break Office Closure Annual Research Credit: We always encourage personal growth, so we provide all of our team members with an annual credit to further enhance your skills! Professional Development: We offer annual reviews, as well as opportunities to collaborate across disciplines, internal tech talks, and the chance to learn from specialists with backgrounds from across the games and software development industries. Work-Life Balance: We really believe that home life comes first and we promote a flexible working environment. And as an added bonus: We don’t crunch! Family Friendly: We understand the importance of family, which is why we offer 6 weeks full of Maternity, Paternity, and Adoption Leave to support you during this exciting time! Office Perks: In addition to everything above, we also provide: Weekly Team Lunches Snacks, Including the Good (Yorkshire) Tea Fully Equipped Team Lounge, Including our Favourite Consoles and Games And, most importantly, a supportive and creative working environment made up of talented and friendly people, as well as the opportunity to work on some pretty cool games and projects – if we do say so ourselves! A FRIENDLY NOTE FROM THE RECRUITMENT TEAM: Let us do the work for you: Even if your profile isn’t an exact match for all of the qualifications listed above, we still want you to apply. Our team members come from a variety of different industries, not all of which are immediately relevant to game or software development, and we welcome all candidates of similarly varied backgrounds, communities, and identities. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our team to meet that demand. The Opportunity We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the core services that underpin Aveni’s platform. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role with responsibility for the architecture, quality and operational reliability of the foundations our product teams build upon. You’ll work across areas including client-data ingestion and preprocessing, CRM integrations and APIs, multi-tenancy, identity and authentication, and data lifecycle and retention. You’ll lead the technical direction of a team of around six to seven engineers, remaining close to the code while making architectural decisions, setting engineering standards and helping other engineers grow. Our platform supports regulated financial-services organisations, so reliability, security, auditability and data isolation aren’t afterthoughts — they’re fundamental to how we design and build. What You’ll Be Doing Owning the technical architecture and direction of Aveni’s core platform services. Designing and building scalable, event-driven services on AWS. Developing and evolving our client-data ingestion capabilities, enabling new clients and data sources to be onboarded increasingly through configuration rather than bespoke engineering. Building and maintaining APIs that give Aveni products a consistent way to consume client and CRM data. Designing robust multi-tenant systems with strong data isolation, security and operational controls. Leading our approach to data lifecycle management, including retention, deletion, residency and GDPR requirements. Building resilient integrations with third-party platforms and APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, retries, reconciliation and failure recovery. Making and documenting architectural decisions and representing Core Services in Architecture Review Board discussions. Raising engineering standards across testing, observability, security, reliability and operational ownership. Remaining hands-on with production code, primarily across Node.js and AWS. Mentoring engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions and technical coaching. Experience building event-driven architectures and an understanding of the challenges that come with asynchronous distributed systems. Experience designing production systems with complex multi-tenancy, data isolation or data lifecycle requirements. Strong experience integrating with third-party APIs and designing for rate limits, partial failures, retries and reconciliation. A strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational ownership. Experience making architectural trade-offs and communicating technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders. A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards. The ability and desire to remain hands-on while providing technical direction to a team. Desirable Production experience with Python alongside Node.js. Experience with identity and access management technologies such as Auth0, AWS Cognito or similar. Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0 and authentication/authorisation patterns. Experience building software within financial services or another regulated environment. Experience handling data residency, retention and GDPR erasure requirements at scale. Experience contributing to Architecture Review Boards or similar technical governance forums. Experience establishing or improving AI-assisted software engineering practices. The Kind of Technical Lead We’re Looking For We’re not looking for someone who has moved completely away from engineering. You’ll still design systems, review code, solve difficult technical problems and contribute to production software. At the same time, you’ll create leverage by helping the engineers around you make better decisions and take greater ownership. You’ll be comfortable asking questions before reaching for a solution, thinking through failure modes as carefully as the happy path, and balancing architectural quality with the realities of delivering software in a fast-growing business. You don’t need to have used every AWS service or technology in our stack. What matters more is that you understand the underlying engineering problems, can explain the trade-offs behind your decisions, and have successfully operated the systems you’ve helped design.   • You're not afraid to be in the weeds, get your hands dirty, and directly drive deals, but you're also passionate about coaching your team to do their best work. You get on aeroplanes at end of quarter, together with your team.

The Role We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data and Insights team. You'll be hands-on every day, writing production code, building and maintaining data pipelines, and shipping features that turn raw data into intelligence our clients can act on. You'll work across the full project lifecycle, from understanding the problem through to delivery, and you'll care as much about code quality and operational reliability as you do about getting things shipped. This is also a technical leadership role. As a senior member of the team, you'll set and lead the technical direction of our Insights platform. This is a visible position within engineering and across the wider business, so you'll explain your thinking clearly, share the reasoning behind it, and bring people with you. You'll do all of this while staying close to the code: it'll suit you if you want to keep building hands-on, rather than move into pure architecture or people management in the near term. What You'll Do Write production code every day, most likely in Python, building and maintaining the data pipelines that power our Insights products. Own the full lifecycle of your projects, from understanding the data domain through to pragmatic design, shipping, and keeping things running reliably in production. Set and lead the technical direction of the Insights platform, and communicate it openly across engineering and the wider business, so product and commercial colleagues understand the choices you are making and why. Help raise engineering standards across the team and improve technical quality through strong engineering practice, including testing, observability, data quality checks, and clean, maintainable code. Make AI your default way of working, and find opportunities to apply it across our products and pipelines where it delivers real value, from research and prototyping through to more operational uses such as agents that help diagnose and fix pipeline issues. Help lay the foundations for our emerging MCP and semantic layer, so our data becomes something both people and AI systems can query and reason over. What You'll Bring Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write well-tested, production-ready Python and care about maintainability, observability, and operational excellence. A track record of building data pipelines and production systems from the ground up, rather than mainly configuring managed services or wiring off-the-shelf tools together. You can describe complex logic you've written and the engineering problems you had to solve. Solid experience with modern data engineering tools and patterns, with real depth in several of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Temporal), and dbt. Comfort with modern deployment practices: CI/CD, containerisation (Docker), and cloud-based infrastructure. It's a bonus if you've shaped these for a team, not only worked within them. A product mindset: you want to understand the business domain and use that understanding to shape what gets built, not only how. You're comfortable pushing back or proposing a different approach when your read of the data and the domain calls for it. The Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data and Insights team. You'll be hands-on every day, writing production code, building and maintaining data pipelines, and shipping features that turn raw data into intelligence our clients can act on. You'll work across the full project lifecycle, from understanding the problem through to delivery, and you'll care as much about code quality and operational reliability as you do about getting things shipped.

This is also a technical leadership role. As a senior member of the team, you'll set and lead the technical direction of our Insights platform. This is a visible position within engineering and across the wider business, so you'll explain your thinking clearly, share the reasoning behind it, and bring people with you. You'll do all of this while staying close to the code: it'll suit you if you want to keep building hands-on, rather than move into pure architecture or people management in the near term.

What You'll Do

  • Write production code every day, most likely in Python, building and maintaining the data pipelines that power our Insights products.

  • Own the full lifecycle of your projects, from understanding the data domain through to pragmatic design, shipping, and keeping things running reliably in production.

  • Set and lead the technical direction of the Insights platform, and communicate it openly across engineering and the wider business, so product and commercial colleagues understand the choices you are making and why.

  • Help raise engineering standards across the team and improve technical quality through strong engineering practice, including testing, observability, data quality checks, and clean, maintainable code.

  • Make AI your default way of working, and find opportunities to apply it across our products and pipelines where it delivers real value, from research and prototyping through to more operational uses such as agents that help diagnose and fix pipeline issues.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics.
