Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We are looking for a Senior Treasury Manager to build and run Finom's treasury function.

Finom safeguards a significant book of customer funds across its regulated entities. Net interest income on that book is a meaningful revenue line, and it will grow. Today the function is up and running: the money is placed, the investment policy is in place, and a large part of the book sits with an external asset manager. What we are building now is the machinery around it — an evidenced limit framework, look-through into what our managers actually hold, automated investment accounting, and a reconciled NII number we can defend to an auditor and a regulator.

That is the job. You will take part in building it, and you will run it while it is being built.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of regulation, liquidity, and commercial impact — not a back-office position. It suits someone who has done this before in a regulated environment and wants to do it again without four layers of committee above them.


What you'll own

Liquidity and funding

  • Daily liquidity positioning and float management across entities and accounts
  • Intraday funding of payment channels; nostro and correspondent account management
  • Collateral and minimum-balance obligations across card schemes, T2, and credit providers
  • Contingency funding — the playbook for the day we need €20m by tomorrow morning
  • A daily treasury balance sheet — net liquidity and net capital available — that reconciles

    • Safeguarding and portfolio

  • Portfolio management of safeguarded client funds: term deposits, MMFs, short-dated debt, held directly and via external managers
  • Safeguarding adequacy: shortfall detection, top-up execution, same-currency discipline
  • Instrument eligibility screening under CRR risk-weight, maturity and WAL constraints, and UCITS/MMF rules
  • Independent, evidenced validation that externally managed allocations sit inside mandate — position-level look-through, daily monitoring of concentration, maturity, WAL and credit quality, breach escalation
  • NII forecasting, attribution, and reconciled performance reporting; treasury inputs into the financial model and company forecast

    • Governance and controls

  • Ownership of the investment policy, limit framework, and eligible-instrument register
  • Treasury governance: decision pack, agenda, decision log, and delegated-authority register
  • Pre-deal checks and post-trade evidencing, designed so that the first line executes and the second line challenges
  • Covenant tracking across credit facilities
  • Regulator, external audit, and second-line engagement on treasury and safeguarding matters

    • Systems and data

  • Selection and implementation of investment accounting and treasury tooling — a Clearwater/Advent-class implementation is already in flight and will be yours
  • Custodian, asset-manager and bank data feeds; API connectivity where it exists and pragmatic alternatives where it doesn't
  • Replacing manual spreadsheet processes with something that survives your holiday

    • Commercial

  • Bank, custodian, broker and asset-manager relationships: onboarding, commercial terms, mandate setting, service review
  • Challenging our managers on allocation, transparency and fees — and changing them if the answers are weak

    • What good looks like in the first 12 months
  • Investment policy and limit framework live, with treasury governance running on a documented decision log
  • Daily, evidenced mandate compliance across the full book — we can answer "are we inside the boundaries?" in minutes, not weeks
  • Investment accounting platform implemented; monthly close on the portfolio no longer manual
  • An NII number that is reconciled, attributed, and forecastable
  • A contingency liquidity playbook that has been tested rather than written

    • Who you are
  • 5+ years in treasury, ALM, fixed income, or portfolio management at a regulated financial institution, EMI/PI, or asset manager
  • Direct experience with client money or safeguarding under PSD2 / EMD — core to this role, not adjacent to it
  • Experience building or materially rebuilding a treasury function, not only operating inside an established one
  • Strong command of bond math, yield and duration, MMF mechanics, and credit and concentration risk at instrument level
  • Track record of automating manual treasury processes and implementing treasury or investment accounting systems
  • Comfortable working with position-level data directly — you can interrogate a portfolio file rather than wait for a report
  • Experience with regulators, external audit, and external asset managers (mandate setting, IMA terms, performance challenge)
  • Sound judgement under time pressure in a lean environment with real accountability and limited cover
  • Strong Excel skills
  • Fluent English
    •  

    Nice to have

  • Familiarity with IFRS 9 or Dutch GAAP (RJ 290) financial instrument accounting
  • SQL or Python
  • Experience in a firm transitioning toward a banking licence
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, copilots) to accelerate analytical and reporting workflows

    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

title: Senior Product Manager,Trust Platform – Modules (f/m/d)
description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

 

This position is based in Berlin/Munich, Germany. 

 

The Trust Platform team builds the capabilities that bring identity and fraud prevention signals together into configurable customer journeys. It gives customers a consistent way to orchestrate signals, configure decision logic, and access outcomes through APIs and a studio. By connecting IDnow products, external providers, and customer needs, the team turns a broad platform ecosystem into clear, scalable solutions. Its work strengthens IDnow’s ability to help businesses make trusted decisions throughout the customer journey. 

 

As (Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform – Modules (f/m/d), you own the product direction for platform capabilities that extend the Trust Platform’s orchestration model, studio, APIs, dashboard, and data layer. You work at the intersection of market and commercial functions, customers, vendors, other IDnow product teams, Engineering, Data, Design, and Analytics. This is the most strategic and market-facing product role in the team, with responsibility for anticipating customer needs and translating them into coherent platform capabilities.  

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • You are very close to our customers and work closely with Sales, Solutions, Marketing, and other commercial functions to assess market needs, anticipate customer problems, and proactively identify viable use cases 
  • Lead the end-to-end integration lifecycle for non-IDnow signals, including biometrics, device fingerprinting, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and sanctions screening, document databases, and credit bureaus, across the orchestration model, studio, and application programming interfaces (APIs) 
  • Conduct commercial and technical evaluations of vendors and lead requests for proposal (RFP) processes to ensure the Trust Platform offers state-of-the-art tools and capabilities 
  • Act as the product counterpart to other IDnow product teams, own the integration of their products into the Trust Platform, and manage cross-functional dependencies 
  • Own the dashboards and analytics features within the Trust Platform dashboard, providing customers with meaningful real-time data on conversion, drop-offs, and fraud 
  • Design unified data schemas and reusable data blocks so signals from different providers use consistent definitions and speak the same language within the Trust Platform 
  • Enable internal teams to understand and navigate the Trust Platform so they can help customers gain the most value from their integration

 

Turn back if …

  • You prefer working on a single product in isolation over orchestrating a broad ecosystem of signals, vendors, and integrations.
  • You prefer to work in a traditional product-owner style that primarily focuses on executing and backlog management
  • You're looking for a highly structured environment where every process already exists.
  • You are uncomfortable working in complex stakeholder environments with multiple priorities and high degree of ambiguity.

 

Preferred Experience 

  • You bring 5+ years of product management experience with end-to-end ownership of product strategy, discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and continuous improvement 
  • You have experience in bringing new products to the market, coordinating go to market activities and pricing of SaaS products 
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, have an easy time managing ambiguity and constantly re-assess the current direction and priorities 
  • Knowledge and experience in digital identity, fraud prevention, risk, compliance, or a regulated industry such as banking, fintech, insurance, or telecommunications is a strong plus 
  • You have experience with platforms, orchestration, APIs, or third-party integrations in a technically complex environment 
  • You are great at building strong relationships with customers and commercial stakeholders, using market conversations to identify meaningful product opportunities 
  • You have a track record of leading vendor evaluations and RFPs across commercial, technical, security, and operational criteria 
  • You an autonomous and pragmatic working style and experience in launching new products, bringing them to the market and scaling them 
  • Communicate complex technical and business topics clearly to senior stakeholders, customers, and internal enablement audiences 

Perks & Benefits 

  • Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo, including 1on1 sessions. 
  • We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited licences.

description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Als Senior Associate – International Operations & Site Build-up bist du eine treibende Kraft hinter einer unserer strategisch wichtigen Initiativen. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und übernimmst Ownership für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Operations-Hubs in Kairo – von der strategischen Konzeption bis in die operative Umsetzung (z. B. PMO für unsere Aufbau-Initiativen, Design des Operating Models für neue Funktionen, Prozessoptimierung gemeinsam mit den Teams vor Ort). Dabei baust du die Brücke zwischen unseren Teams in Deutschland und Ägypten – mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung, steiler Lernkurve und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum vom ersten Tag an. Ramp-up Planung Du entwickelst detaillierte Pläne für den Aufbau neuer Teams und Funktionen in Kairo – inklusive Wissensaufbau und Ressourcenplanung. Operating Model & Prozessdesign Du gestaltest das Operating Model für die neuen Funktionen, prüfst Workflows auf Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit und optimierst die Prozesse gemeinsam mit dem Team. PMO & Program Governance Du baust das PMO-Framework für unsere Aufbau-Initiativen auf, steuerst Timelines und schaffst Transparenz für die Führung an beiden Standorten. Financial Tracking Du verfolgst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung gegen den Business Case und machst die Ergebnisse für die Geschäftsführung transparent. Continuous Improvement Cross-functional Collaboration Du bist eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen allen internen Bereichen in Deutschland und in Kairo und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven pragmatisch zusammen. Dein Profil Relevante Erfahrung 2–4 Jahre in Top-Tier Consulting oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Aufbau internationaler Standorte (z. B. in einem GCC, BPO oder Shared-Service-Center). Strukturierte Problemlösung Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Situationen und übersetzt unklare Ausgangslagen in pragmatische Lösungen – auf dem Papier und im Alltag. Business Case & Financial Acumen Du fühlst Dich sicher in Business Cases, Cost-Benefit-Analysen und KPI-Tracking und begründest wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen fundiert. Eigenverantwortung & Umsetzungsstärke Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Workstreams und bringst Themen mit hoher Eigenständigkeit ins Ziel – hands-on, pragmatisch, ergebnisorientiert. Interkulturelle Kommunikationsstärke Klar und adressatengerecht – vom Werkstudiernden bis zum Management, über Standort- und Kulturgrenzen hinweg. Deutsch und Englisch auf C1+ Niveau. Reisebereitschaft Ca. eine Woche pro Monat vor Ort in Kairo, die restliche Zeit aus unserem Office in Berlin. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed. Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production. Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start. Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving. Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows. YOUR PROFILE You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory. You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations. You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements. You take ownership and follow through. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI. Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Ensure system quality can be measured reliably and regressions are identified before reaching users. Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, actively contributing to high engineering standards across the team. Research and experiment with new AI models, methods, and technologies, turning promising approaches into practical features and production solutions. Work closely with engineers, data specialists, and domain experts to develop effective solutions for real-world telecom challenges. Your profile PhD in a quantitative discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Computational Chemistry/Biology, or a related natural science, with strong hands-on experience in mathematical and computational modeling. Minimum 3 years of experience developing software or machine learning systems in an industry or research environment, alongside or following your studies. Strong background in data science and machine learning, with experience using tools and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, and deep learning frameworks. title: Senior Process Engieer
description: ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a cleaner and more innovative future. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs ● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently. ● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation. ● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews, ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather than after installation. ● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process parameters of newly commissioned systems. Nice-to-have's: Vendor & EPC Coordination ● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners and equipment suppliers. ● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering documentation. ● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process. ● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability. ● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and equipment vendors throughout project execution. Your profile You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and real plant data. ● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or a related technical field. ● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical, hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing is highly preferred. ● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs, mass/energy balances and equipment sizing. ● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data into engineering models and decisions. ● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation, hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable. ● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical assumptions. ● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of industrial equipment or plants. ● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA. ● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering documentation and the actual plant. ● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering, Operations, suppliers and EPC partners. ● Fluent English; German is a plus. Why us? Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward increasingly larger and more standardized plants. The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts. You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it. title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

 

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. title: Engineering Manager
description: At NetBox Labs, our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud. We believe in the power of community and collaboration, and we are looking for a hands-on, player-coach Engineering Manager to lead one of our talented teams. These teams build our core software applications including NetBox and NetBox Add-ons, SDKs, and Plugins, and our observability suite including Diode, Diode Agents and SDKs, and Orb. Much of this development is open source and done in collaboration with our community, but also spans source-available and proprietary software. This role reports to the Director of Engineering. In this role you will: Lead a squad of engineers day-to-day while staying hands-on: reviewing code, jumping into design discussions, and occasionally shipping code yourself to unblock the team or model best practices. Drive execution relentlessly — break down ambiguous problems into clear plans, set sprint goals, remove blockers fast, and hold the team accountable to deadlines. Own the software development lifecycle for your team's projects, from planning and design through implementation, testing, and release. Run effective sprint planning, stand-ups, and retros using GitHub and internal tools, helping engineers break work into well-scoped, executable pieces. Champion modern, secure software development practices and keep quality bars high without slowing the team down. Partner closely with product managers to translate customer and community problems into shippable plans, pushing back with data when scope or timelines don't add up. Coach and mentor engineers individually — give direct, timely feedback, help them grow technically, and build a strong bench for future hiring. Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team. Act as a liaison between your team and the broader tech community, supporting open-source contributors and guiding community-facing initiatives where relevant. Report progress transparently to engineering leadership, flagging risks early rather than after they've become problems. Stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make credible calls on technical trade-offs, while trusting your engineers to own the details of implementation. You will work closely with: Director of Engineering to coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure your team's work runs smoothly in our commercial products. Product team to understand customer and community problems and turn them into a stellar user experience. Peer engineering managers to plan cross-functional projects, clarify ownership, surface dependencies, and clear blockers together. Qualifications: 2+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead, ideally in a player-coach capacity where you're still writing code or reviewing PRs regularly. A track record of driving projects to completion on tight timelines, with a strong bias toward action and unblocking your team over process for its own sake. Strong technical background sufficient to review designs and code, and earn credibility with senior engineers. Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps, and CI/CD in a fast-moving environment. Proficiency with GitHub for code management, project tracking, and collaboration. Solid understanding of software security principles and practices. Experience with open-source software development and community engagement is a plus. Excellent, direct communication skills — comfortable giving and receiving fast feedback in a remote, async-first environment. Proven ability to coach engineers and help them grow, while still being the person who rolls up their sleeves when the team needs it. It would be fantastic if you have the following background: Networking industry experience. Familiarity with Python, Django, Go, gRPC, or OpenTelemetry. Knowledge of cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure). Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of data privacy regulations and compliance requirements. About NetBox Labs: NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community. NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox. NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital. Our culture and values: We own and solve problems with high attention to detail. Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win. We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly. NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions. Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience. Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. raw.title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead
raw.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

This position involves travelling across different European countries 🚃

title: Sr. Advisor AI Transformation & Automation (w/m/d) E-Commerce
description: Bei IONOS arbeitest Du bei dem führenden europäischen Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Dienstleistungen partnerschaftlich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Job und Spaß vereinbar sind und bieten Dir hierfür das entsprechende Umfeld. Bei ständigem Wachstum sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Teammitgliedern. Werde Teil von IONOS und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Du bist leidenschaftlich an der transformativen Kraft künstlicher Intelligenz interessiert? Wir suchen einen Senior Advisor AI Transformation , der als strategischer und operativer Katalysator für unseren Bereich E-Commerce fungiert. In dieser Rolle wirst Du die KI-Evolution in diesen Bereichen gezielt vorantreiben und die Lücke zwischen hochkarätiger Innovation und praktischer Befähigung schließen. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Teams an der Spitze KI-gestützter Customer Journeys und Bestellstrecken stehen. Aufgabenbereich Als Sr. Advisor ist es Deine Mission, unsere operativen Experten zu befähigen. Du agierst als strategischer Berater, technischer Mentor und praktischer Umsetzer – und stellst die Werkzeuge, Prototypen und das Wissen bereit, die unsere Teams benötigen, um Spitzenleistungen zu erbringen. Während die Fachabteilungen die Verantwortung für ihre Ergebnisse behalten, lieferst Du das KI-gestützte „Wie“ zu deren „Was“. Prozesstransformation: Unterstützen Sie unsere Teams bei der Steigerung der Effizienz in den Bereichen Kampagnenidee, -erstellung und -analyse, indem Sie die richtigen KI-Tools identifizieren und in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe integrieren. Sie treiben die KI-Transformation rund um unsere Online-Shops und Vertriebsplattformen voran und nehmen die beteiligten Organisationen dabei mit. Kampagneneffektivität: Beraten Sie bei der Nutzung von KI zur Steigerung der Personalisierung und Effektivität in Kampagnen und Vertriebsinitiativen. Requirements Engineering: Fungieren Sie als Lead für unsere internen Tools, indem Sie klare, hochwertige Geschäftsanforderungen definieren, die von den Entwicklungsteams in unserer Kerninfrastruktur umgesetzt werden. Prototyping & „Vibe Coding“: Packen Sie mit an und erstellen Sie funktionale Prototypen von KI-basierten Prozessen unter Verwendung interner/externer Tools und Natural Language Coding, um Konzepte zu beweisen und Anforderungen zu validieren. Qualifikationen Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der digitalen Transformation, Marketing-Technologie oder Entwicklung, mit einem klaren Fokus auf KI-Implementierung. Hands-on Builder: Sie beraten nicht nur; Sie bauen. Sie fühlen sich sicher im Umgang mit „Vibe Coding“, Rapid Prototyping und dem tiefen Eintauchen in KI-Tools, um zu sehen, was in der Praxis funktioniert. Das „Enabler“-Mindset: Sie sind ein natürlicher Vermittler, der seinen Erfolg darin findet, anderen zum Erfolg zu verhelfen. Sie können komplexe KI-Logik nicht-technischen Kollegen mit Leichtigkeit erklären. Technischer Übersetzer: Sie besitzen die ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, geschäftliche Anforderungen in präzise technische Vorgaben für externe Entwicklungsteams zu übersetzen. Sprache: Fließende Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Deutsch oder andere europäische Sprachen sind ein Plus. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit. An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke. Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte. Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops. Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse. Über IONOS IONOS ist der führende europäische Digitalisierungs-Partner für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU). IONOS hat mehr als sechs Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und ist mit einer weltweit verfügbaren Plattform in 18 Märkten in Europa und Nordamerika aktiv. Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten. Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht. title: Content Marketing Manager (all genders)
description: Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing, Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations and shifts. We think writing will increasingly be handled by AI. Knowing what to write about will not, and neither will writing something that is actually worth reading. The value moves to the person who can build two kinds of knowledge fast. First, the topic. What a HACCP verification actually involves in a restaurant chain, why a bakery fails a hygiene audit, what a fleet manager is dealing with when hundreds of vehicles need daily checks across a country. The problems, the standards, the vocabulary, the things that go wrong. Second, the product. What Lumiform actually does, how logic, scoring, offline capture and workflow automation work, and where the product genuinely solves that specific problem versus where it does not. You build both by reading primary sources, watching customer demos and talking to the people in sales and success who hear these problems every day. The content that wins is written where those two meet. On top of that sits original research. This is our biggest growth bet, and it will be yours to own. Benchmark reports that give this category a reference point it currently does not have, shared with industry bodies and journalists. You come up with the angle, find the data and build something worth citing. This is a research and expertise role that ends in writing, not a writing role that starts with a prompt. You go deep, get technical, learn faster than seems reasonable, then produce content that reads like a human wrote it. Tasks Your core mandate sits on four priorities. 1. Topic ownership and expertise Own assigned topic areas and content clusters. Within weeks you are the person in the company who knows the most about your topics. Build that knowledge from primary sources, customer demos and conversations with sales and success. Know the product properly and be able to adapt it to specific use cases and competitor comparisons. 2. Benchmark reports and original research Our biggest growth bet. You come up with the ideas, define the angle and decide what is worth measuring. Research internal and external data and build reports at an academic level of rigor that hold up when a journalist or industry body checks them, then work with the marketing managers to get them in front of the right people. 3. Content production Write app use pages that show exactly how Lumiform works for a specific industry use case, from HACCP and fire safety to vehicle inspections. Write listicles, competitor comparison pages and best-alternative pages that position Lumiform clearly against each competitor and around topics. Write customer stories based on real interviews, plus newsletters and other marketing materials. 4. Publishing and maintenance Publish and manage content in WordPress, applying SEO and AEO fundamentals. Improve existing content on quality, relevance, structure and performance. Use actual data from demos and customer calls to turn them into FAQs and on-page answers, so the website handles objections before a prospect asks one of our reps. Requirements Required 4+ years in content marketing, meaningful time spent in B2B SaaS A smart mind with a top university degree Native-level English writing. This role produces English content for an international audience and the bar is publication quality. Proven independent research. You have found data, worked with primary sources, judged what is reliable and built something original out of it. Bring examples. You develop expertise fast. Hand you an unfamiliar regulated topic on Monday and you can hold a credible conversation with a practitioner by Friday Technical curiosity. You want to understand how a product actually works and which problems it solves. You are able to use AI properly. It accelerates research and drafting, and the output is never final. You revise, restructure and add what the model cannot, which is judgement, a point of view and a reason the piece exists. You write clearly, creatively and in an approachable, human way. No filler, no throat-clearing, no AI slop. You bring your own ideas. You propose topics and reports rather than waiting for a brief. Reliable, diligent and proactive. You take ownership of your work, meet deadlines and pay close attention to accuracy, quality and consistency. Strongly preferred Experience building benchmark reports, surveys or other original research content Familiarity with WordPress Basic SEO understanding, including keyword research, keyword integration, headings, internal linking and content optimisation You have already heard of AEO (answer engine optimization) and understand why it matters. It is our biggest growth engine. Experience writing about regulated or technical subjects such as food safety, quality, EHS or logistics Benefits About Lumiform Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance. Why working with us You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm. Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy. You work closely with two marketing managers and directly with our founders. Own a growth bet from scratch. Benchmark reports will carry your name and go out to industry bodies, journalists and analysts. Go deep on subjects most marketers never touch. You leave here knowing more about inspections, audits and frontline operations than almost anyone in the market. Work fully remote and choose where you get things done If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough. If you have written something you are proud of, a benchmark report, a deeply researched piece, anything that took real work, send it along. Our Hiring Process Screening call (30 minutes) with HR First interview (general get to know call) with founder (30 minutes) Second interview (deep dive interview) with founder We ask you for 2 references and will conduct reference calls (as a final step) Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • Own assigned topic areas and content clusters. Within weeks you are the person in the company who knows the most about your topics.
  • Build that knowledge from primary sources, customer demos and conversations with sales and success.
  • Know the product properly and be able to adapt it to specific use cases and competitor comparisons.

2. Benchmark reports and original research

  • Our biggest growth bet. You come up with the ideas, define the angle and decide what is worth measuring.
  • Research internal and external data and build reports at an academic level of rigor that hold up when a journalist or industry body checks them, then work with the marketing managers to get them in front of the right people.

3. Content production

  • Write app use pages that show exactly how Lumiform works for a specific industry use case, from HACCP and fire safety to vehicle inspections.
  • Write listicles, competitor comparison pages and best-alternative pages that position Lumiform clearly against each competitor and around topics.
  • Write customer stories based on real interviews, plus newsletters and other marketing materials.

4. Publishing and maintenance

  • Publish and manage content in WordPress, applying SEO and AEO fundamentals.
  • Improve existing content on quality, relevance, structure and performance.
  • Use actual data from demos and customer calls to turn them into FAQs and on-page answers, so the website handles objections before a prospect asks one of our reps.

Requirements

Required

  • 4+ years in content marketing, meaningful time spent in B2B SaaS
  • A smart mind with a top university degree
  • Native-level English writing. This role produces English content for an international audience and the bar is publication quality.
  • Proven independent research. You have found data, worked with primary sources, judged what is reliable and built something original out of it. Bring examples.
  • You develop expertise fast. Hand you an unfamiliar regulated topic on Monday and you can hold a credible conversation with a practitioner by Friday
  • Technical curiosity. You want to understand how a product actually works and which problems it solves.
  • You are able to use AI properly. It accelerates research and drafting, and the output is never final. You revise, restructure and add what the model cannot, which is judgement, a point of view and a reason the piece exists.
  • You write clearly, creatively and in an approachable, human way. No filler, no throat-clearing, no AI slop.
  • You bring your own ideas. You propose topics and reports rather than waiting for a brief.
  • Reliable, diligent and proactive. You take ownership of your work, meet deadlines and pay close attention to accuracy, quality and consistency.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience building benchmark reports, surveys or other original research content
  • Familiarity with WordPress
  • Basic SEO understanding, including keyword research, keyword integration, headings, internal linking and content optimisation
  • You have already heard of AEO (answer engine optimization) and understand why it matters. It is our biggest growth engine.
  • Experience writing about regulated or technical subjects such as food safety, quality, EHS or logistics

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

Why working with us

  • You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm.
  • Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy. You work closely with two marketing managers and directly with our founders.
  • Own a growth bet from scratch. Benchmark reports will carry your name and go out to industry bodies, journalists and analysts.
  • Go deep on subjects most marketers never touch. You leave here knowing more about inspections, audits and frontline operations than almost anyone in the market.
  • Work fully remote and choose where you get things done

If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough. If you have written something you are proud of, a benchmark report, a deeply researched piece, anything that took real work, send it along.

  • First interview (general get to know call) with founder (30 minutes)

title: Sr. Manager, Regulatory Affairs
description:
The Senior Manager, Regulatory Affairs will work with EU regulatory lead(s) and/or directly with global regulatory lead(s) and within cross-functional teams to facilitate submission of applications to EU and International health agencies (HA) for Alnylam’s RNAi therapeutics.  The role will work across programs to support the development of Alnylam’s products globally.  In doing so they are responsible for planning and coordinating all aspects of regulatory submissions necessary to support product development, clinical trials and product registration. The role will contribute to regulatory strategy and may represent the department on multidisciplinary product development subteams.  Additional responsibilities include involvement in the writing and oversight of regulatory submissions, coordinating all aspects of paper and electronic regulatory submissions, proactively keeping updated on EU regulatory requirements and internationally as relevant, and distributing regulatory intelligence to internal teams.

Summary of Key Responsibilities

  • Work with EU/Global regulatory lead  to lead the planning, preparation (including authoring where relevant) and delivery of both simple and complex regulatory submissions throughout the product's life cycle.  This may include relevant forms, new Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs) responses to questions, substantial modifications, notifications etc, meeting requests, Briefing Documents for HA meetings.  Role may also include supporting preparation of  Paediatric Plans, Orphan Designation, Expedited Pathway Applications (e.g. PRIME), and Marketing Applications and any amendments.
  • Develop detailed regulatory project plans and support regulatory activities relating to specific portfolio of products/projects.
  • Serve as member of the Global Regulatory Team, may serve as Regulatory representative in multidisciplinary product subteams for assigned programs and participate as an active team member and provide EU regulatory advice.
  • Coordinate responses to regulatory authorities’ questions with strict adherence to deadlines.
  • Serve as a liaison within internal departments at Alnylam, with CROs and with regulatory program managers at HAs.
  • Maintain regulatory files in a format consistent with internal requirements.
  • Facilitate as necessary the review of technical regulatory documentation and recommend changes to documentation or processes, including SOPs for regulatory compliance.
  • Provide EU specific regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders as appropriate.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 4 or more years of experience in a Regulatory Affairs strategy role working in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry. Advanced scientific degree preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Solid understanding of regulations and experience in interpretation of guidelines.
  • Ability to think strategically and to proactively identify issues and mitigation strategies in various aspects of the drug development process.
  • Experience with regulatory filings, including electronic submissions, e.g., CTAs, DSURs, post-marketing variations, paediatric plans, ODD etc.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills; demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple projects.
  • Ability to work in a team environment, possessing interpersonal skills to work effectively with other departments at various levels and with CROs and external consultants.

About the team

The Core Engineering teams build the systems and tooling that enable Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash engineers to develop, ship, and operate software at scale. We treat infrastructure, CI / CD, and developer tooling as software products, engineered with the same care as customer-facing systems. Our mission is to increase engineering velocity, reliability, and security as we transform the way the world eats and shops.

Working in the Infrastructure team, you’ll be responsible for the foundational compute and cloud components that product engineering teams build on: our Kubernetes clusters, related cloud infrastructure and networking, and the Infrastructure-as-Code and provisioning frameworks that let our teams safely self-serve environments and capacity. Expect to split your time between hands-on operational ownership and writing production-quality code to build automation / tooling that removes toil and friction, while also designing and running scalable systems in AWS.

What you’ll do

  • Take ownership of complex infrastructure initiatives end-to-end, spanning Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networking, and infrastructure-as-code frameworks - making most technical decisions within scope without needing oversight.

  • Break initiatives down into executable work, identify dependencies, provide accurate estimates, and document project-level technical decisions and how infrastructure components interact.

  • Design, deploy, and operate secure, scalable systems in AWS, and know when and how to pull in other teams to support cross-cutting initiatives.

  • Independently plan and drive technical improvements to the compute and cloud platform, using data and clear success metrics to prioritize work.

  • Build and own self-service tooling, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks that let other engineering teams provision environments and infrastructure safely and consistently.

  • Unblock other teams through code and design reviews, proactively answering questions, and sharing knowledge via guides, playbooks, and internal tech talks.

  • Serve as a first responder during on-call rotations for core infrastructure, lead root cause analysis, and drive incident mitigation and follow-through.

  • Act as a role model for other engineers by sharing constructive feedback, recognizing colleagues' contributions, and supporting hiring through interviewing and recruiting activities.

  • Experience with GitOps tooling (e.g. Argo CD, Flux), progressive delivery, or service mesh technologies.

  • Experience operating multi-cluster or multi-region Kubernetes environments at scale.

  • GCP exposure, especially compute and networking aspects.
