  • Design and operate automated CI/CD pipelines that build, test, scan, sign, publish, promote, and retire images across environments and architectures
  • Write tooling and tests to assess security compliance and cloud-native compatibility
  • Work closely with the community and partners to share container expertise and keep our portfolio current with new features, patches, and applications
  • Collaborate with our product security, platform, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams
  • Contribute technical input to the team's decision-making
  • Set the standard for quality, defining image standards that span security, compatibility, performance, size, and developer experience
  • Grow our knowledge base and write about the work we do
  • Work in a collaborative, agile, and globally distributed environment
  • Mentor colleagues and contribute to hiring
  • Work from home with global travel of up to 15% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Proficiency in Bash and Python
  • Experience working with CI/CD systems (e.g. GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
  • Experience building container images
  • Command of at least one container management or orchestration tool (e.g. Docker, Podman, or Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Linux systems, package management, build systems, release engineering, or artifact pipelines
  • Clear communication and end-to-end ownership, spanning design, review, documentation, operation, and cross-team collaboration
  • A commitment to sharing knowledge and helping those around you grow
  • A genuine appetite for learning and for working outside your comfort zone
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, a STEM field, or a similar discipline
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Business level written and spoken English.
  • Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
  • International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
  • 0-7 years relevant experience.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

  • Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
  • Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
  • Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
  • Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

Nice-to-have skills

  • A security-oriented maintenance mindset: you can investigate dependency and vulnerability findings, assess their impact, and deliver a safe fix
  • An understanding of software supply chain security, with some experience generating and consuming artifacts such as SBOMs, signatures, provenance, or CVE reports
  • Familiarity with GitOps principles and workflows
  • Familiarity with additional languages such as Go or Rust
  • Hands-on experience building minimal and distroless container images
  • Knowledge of the OCI specifications
  • Familiarity with security or compliance frameworks such as CIS, NIST, FedRAMP, or DISA STIG
  • Evidence of contributions to open source projects
  • A passion for embedding security across all stages of the engineering lifecycle (DevSecOps), and an interest in using AI or agentic development responsibly and safely
  • Relevant Linux, container, or cloud-native certifications (such as CKS or DCA) are welcome

If your experience is close but does not match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience from Linux packaging, release engineering, build systems, platform engineering, and open-source maintenance.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Bi-annual compensation review
  • Company recognition rewards
  • 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.jobDescription:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// As part of the Passenger Apps team, you'll lead the delivery and ongoing development of Masabi's native passenger applications, the white-label Justride/Passenger experience deployed across transit agencies worldwide, spanning iOS, Android and Web.

This is a hands-on Technical Lead role with a balance of approximately 50% technical contribution and 50% people leadership, delivery management and team coordination. Alongside supporting a team of engineers, you'll remain actively involved in technical design, implementation, code reviews and delivery planning, focused on integrating Masabi's Justride SDK and public API platform capabilities.

Location_

// This role is available in a remote model for candidates based in Poland

Type of Role_

// This role is available as an up to 12 months Fixed Term Contract

Responsibilities_

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Own delivery across the Passenger iOS, Android and Web applications, clearing blockers and keeping releases predictable

  • Remain actively involved in technical implementation, design discussions and code reviews, setting the bar for engineering quality

  • Drive the integration of Masabi's Justride SDK and public APIs into Passenger applications

  • Lead application migrations, release management, rollout planning and deployment activities

  • Support engineering practices that enable effective delivery across the team

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and support a team of engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, performance feedback and clear development conversations

  • Create an environment where engineers can grow, develop and do their best work

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering stakeholders to align priorities, delivery plans and team goals

  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team culture

  • Contribute to hiring, onboarding and team growth activities as needed

  • Provide visibility on delivery progress, risks and dependencies to stakeholders

About You_

  • Strong hands-on engineer at heart, current in at least one native platform (Swift/UIKit or Kotlin/Coroutines) and able to move confidently across both

  • You’ve led technical delivery across engineering teams, owning quality through code review and design guidance rather than stepping back from the work

  • You've managed and grown engineers directly, running 1:1s, coaching and honest feedback

  • Comfortable in multi-tenant or white-label products, where one codebase serves many customers with different needs

  • Experience delivering and evolving production applications, including migrations or modernisation efforts

  • Knowledgeable and experienced in SDK and API integrations

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools and able to demonstrate how you’ve incorporated them into engineering workflow

  • A calm communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and can hold the balance between coding and leading

Nice to Have_

  • Familiarity with release management, rollout strategies and deployment processes

  • Knowledge of CI/CD tooling and engineering quality practices

  • Participation in hiring, onboarding or team growth initiatives

  • Prior experience in Fintech or Transit domains

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
description: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer – Fusion Operations Location: Portugal (Hybrid/Remote options available) Position Overview Autodesk is seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our Fusion Operations team in Portugal. Fusion Operations is a cloud-based Manufacturing Execution System (MES) that provides real-time visibility into production processes—from raw materials to final delivery. It enables manufacturers to optimize scheduling, track inventory, monitor operations, and ensure product quality and compliance. description: Job Requisition ID # 26WD94957 Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. Ability to collaborate with a global team. Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core: Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. Bonus: Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. About the Team The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. Why Join Us Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry. raw.title: Senior Shopify Developer
raw.description:
We are hiring a contract-based Senior Shopify Developer to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

Original Job posting link here

 

🌎About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

  • Lightphone
  • Mill
  • IngredientAI

 

🔮 Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
  • Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
  • Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
  • Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
  • Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
  • Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
  • Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
  • Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

 

🔑 Must-Have Competencies:

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

  • 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
  • Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js.
  • Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
  • Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
  • Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
  • Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
  • Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
  • Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

 

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

  • Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
  • Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
  • WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
  • Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
  • Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

 

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

 
🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

 
👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here, or our Medium, over there.

 
Important Reminders

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

title: Marketing Web Developer
description: A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation ! This role brings front-end development expertise alongside a growth mindset, a collaborative approach, and a focus on optimizing the entire customer journey. You will be responsible for maintaining and implementing new web experiences on the Marketing website, with an emphasis on creating high-converting landing pages and funnels. The role ensures web initiatives are aligned with quarterly business objectives and broader company growth goals. Your Impact As a Web Developer on our Marketing Team, you’ll help shape and scale our most important marketing asset: the marketing website. You’ll build and optimize high-converting web experiences with a strong focus on web performance, SEO, and conversion rates. You’ll collaborate with partners across the company to plan and execute larger initiatives from technical scoping through delivery. As a member of the website team, you’ll perform code reviews, support ongoing site maintenance, monitor accessibility and performance, and collaborate closely with partners across Content, Brand, and other teams to deliver high-quality web experiences. Your Experience Technical Skills 2+ years of professional web development experience; B2B SaaS experience preferred. Extensive experience building user-facing web applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Next.js), including: Dynamic routing, data-fetching patterns, and rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR, CSR). State management and front-end performance optimization. Strong proficiency with modern CSS and styling approaches, including utility-first frameworks such as Tailwind CSS. Experience building and customizing headless CMS solutions and integrating them into front-end applications; familiarity with Sanity and GROQ is a plus. Strong understanding of web performance best practices and their impact on SEO, Core Web Vitals, and conversion rates, with hands-on experience measuring and improving performance using browser tooling and real-world metrics. Experience with modern front-end build tooling, including Webpack configuration, loaders, plugins, and build pipeline troubleshooting. Experience planning projects end-to-end, including technical scoping, estimation, and task breakdown. Strong experience with Git and collaborative workflows, including leading and participating in code reviews. Soft Skills Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently plan, prioritize, and deliver complex projects. Excellent collaboration skills, working cross-functionally with Marketing, Design, Product, MOPs, Sales, and Engineering. Comfortable mentoring other developers and providing clear, constructive feedback through code reviews. Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strategic thinker who aligns technical decisions with business goals and customer acquisition outcomes. Proficiency in Google Analytics, including setting up and mapping events, tracking and analyzing data, and using Google Search Console to connect SEO insights to website optimization decisions. Ability to apply marketing goals and metrics to web builds, including attributing MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline impact to development work within the Revenue Marketing umbrella. Personal interest in staying current with emerging tools, frameworks, and best practices in front-end development. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will. If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

title: Software Engineer, Analytics
description: Software Engineer, Analytics In Brief We’re an early-stage startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You will lead the development of our clinical AI/ML product analytics infrastructure, frameworks, and tools to enable our client success, product, clinical, and technology teams to uplevel our decision making through better insights. Who We Are Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What you'll do As a Senior Software Engineer, Analytics, you will work closely with client success, product managers, clinicians, data scientists, and other software engineers to build infrastructure, frameworks, and tools to improve client analytics, facilitate clinical case reviews, and support product investigation. This role is crucial to provide internal visibility into product performance that will drive expansion of our clinical AI/ML module offerings and revenue growth. Responsibilities Product performance monitoring and optimization: Partner with client success and clinical product subject matter experts to implement the infrastructure, queries, and automation to monitor the KPIs and success metrics of our products across multiple clinical domains and clients. Clinical case review and investigation : Build frameworks and tools to empower our clinical team to independently review and investigate clinical cases reported by our clients and identify cases with certain criteria that need further evaluation. Data platform and analytics technical foundations: Propose and implement foundational improvements and innovations to boost our data platform scalability with expanding products and clients and uplevel our team analytics capabilities. Drive product analytics development cross-functionally: Work closely with Client Success, Clinical, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to drive alignment on product analytics at the company level. Minimum qualifications BS in Computer Science or other relevant technical discipline. 5+ years of experience in building scalable, secure analytics infrastructure and tools on a cloud platform (preferably AWS) to produce monitoring metrics and investigational data from complex data models and queries for live products and customers. Proficient in Python and SQL. Deep knowledge in modern data and analytics technologies, such as cloud-based data warehouses, transformation frameworks (e.g. dbt), workflow orchestration tools, and BI tools like Tableau or Quicksight, and keen ability to integrate with existing infrastructure to enhance capabilities. Experience working with sensitive data that contains PHI/PII. Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (data science, product, clinical) to translate requirements into robust technical solutions Preferred qualifications Experience in leveraging LLMs in distributed data processing and analytics systems. Experience building analytics technology for clinical/health data. Experience handling ambiguity and uncertainty in a startup. Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Software Engineer, Analytics

In Brief

  • We’re an early-stage startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

  • You will lead the development of our clinical AI/ML product analytics infrastructure, frameworks, and tools to enable our client success, product, clinical, and technology teams to uplevel our decision making through better insights.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved.

What you'll do

As a Senior Software Engineer, Analytics, you will work closely with client success, product managers, clinicians, data scientists, and other software engineers to build infrastructure, frameworks, and tools to improve client analytics, facilitate clinical case reviews, and support product investigation. This role is crucial to provide internal visibility into product performance that will drive expansion of our clinical AI/ML module offerings and revenue growth.

Responsibilities

  • Product performance monitoring and optimization: Partner with client success and clinical product subject matter experts to implement the infrastructure, queries, and automation to monitor the KPIs and success metrics of our products across multiple clinical domains and clients.

  • Clinical case review and investigation: Build frameworks and tools to empower our clinical team to independently review and investigate clinical cases reported by our clients and identify cases with certain criteria that need further evaluation.

  • Data platform and analytics technical foundations: Propose and implement foundational improvements and innovations to boost our data platform scalability with expanding products and clients and uplevel our team analytics capabilities.

  • Drive product analytics development cross-functionally: Work closely with Client Success, Clinical, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to drive alignment on product analytics at the company level.

raw.jobDescription:
Overzicht

Kom de toekomst van het internet vormgeven met je dagelijkse internetvaardigheden!

Als Ads Quality Rater beoordeel en evalueer je internetadvertenties om ze beter en relevanter te maken voor eindgebruikers zoals jijzelf.

Met andere woorden, je vertelt het systeem hoe goed of hoe slecht een advertentie is op basis van je begrip van de trefwoorden die bij elke advertentie verstrekt worden. Je beoordeelt advertenties zowel in het Engels als in het Nederlands.

Deze functie is ideaal voor mensen die:

· Dagelijks op het internet surfen

· Vaak grote zoekmachines gebruiken

· Advertenties herkennen wanneer ze verschijnen

· Houden van online onderzoek doen over verschillende onderwerpen

Daarnaast moeten alle Ads Quality Raters een geheimhoudingsovereenkomst ondertekenen en slagen voor een door de klant verstrekte test voordat ze worden aangenomen.

Deze cruciale stappen garanderen geheimhouding van de klant en een hoog kwaliteitsniveau.

Projectdetails

Functieomschrijving: Ads Quality Rater

Salaris: per taak (ca. $17 USD per uur)

Locatie: op afstand, Nederland

Uren: bepaal je eigen schema gebaseerd op het volgende: minimale inzet is 10 uur per week. Je kunt ervoor kiezen om tot 20 uur per week te werken (als het project dit toelaat).

Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk

Dienstverband: freelance; betaling elke 2 weken

Projectduur: 12 maanden (met mogelijkheid tot verlenging)

De hoeveelheid van data kan van week tot week variëren. Sommige weken is er meer data om te beoordelen, andere weken minder. Van alle Ads Quality Raters wordt verwacht dat zij minimaal 10 uur per week werken.

Aanwervingsproces en stappen

Welo Data streeft naar een inclusief en rechtvaardig wervingsproces. Alle kandidaten dienen de volgende stappen doorlopen om in aanmerking te komen voor dit project:

• Sollicitatie kandidaat

• Welo Data beoordeling sollicitatie

• Kennis, evaluatie en kwalificatie kandidaat

• Welo Data’s klant beoordeling

• Definitieve goedkeuring

Het wervingsproces kan tot 14 dagen in beslag nemen.

Ervaring en vereisten

  • Vloeiend in Nederlands (geschreven en gesproken)
  • Conversationeel in Engels
  • Betrouwbaar computersysteem en internetverbinding
  • Bekend met het gebruik van online zoekmachines
  • Kan instructies in het Engels ontvangen en begrijpen en kan voldoen aan de projectconventies en -regels die door de klant worden verwacht
  • Bereid om een geheimhoudingsverklaring te tekenen ter bescherming van de klant
  • Voldoet aan de leermodules en een vereiste kwaliteitstest ontworpen door onze klant voordat het werk begint

Compensation

Additional Information

Overige informatie

Preventie van fraude

Projecten zoals deze zijn over de hele wereld grote doelwitten van fraude. Daarom voert Welo Data gedurende het hele proces fraudecontroles uit om ervoor te zorgen dat het programma wordt nageleefd. Alle accounts die frauduleus worden bevonden, worden onmiddellijk van het project verwijderd.

Over Welo Data

Welo Data is een wereldwijd data- en vertaalbedrijf met kantoren over de hele wereld. We hebben achter de schermen gewerkt aan een aantal van de grootste technische projecten ooit, van datalokalisatie en vertaling tot generatieve AI en deep learning. We zijn buitengewoon trots op onze klanten, onze medewerkers en de eindgebruikers van alle projecten waar we aan werken.

Please note that this work is based on project needs. Due to this, weekly hours may vary and flexibility with change is expected. You must legally be able to work on freelance projects in the Netherlands.

JOB ID: FEQ427R333

Location: Leeds/Manchester, United Kingdom - remote contract

Industry: Enterprise Retail or CPG (UKI Enterprise)

The Role

As a Sr. Solutions Architect, you are an expert-level technical leader responsible for the organisation's most complex customer engagements. You drive consumption strategy, own executive-level relationships, and serve as the definitive technical authority for your accounts. You have declared your archetype—a recognised technical specialisation that makes you a force multiplier across your team and region. You operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic account planning, and executive influence.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Drive the technical and consumption strategy for the organisation's most complex customer engagements, directly influencing platform adoption and revenue growth.
  • Own senior-level technical relationships — serving as a trusted advisor on enterprise data and AI strategy
  • Lead the most complex architecture engagements: multi-workload platforms, enterprise-wide migrations, real-time systems, and AI/ML at scale
  • Operate as an Expert on the Databricks Platform with a declared archetype — actively mentoring others and driving horizontal impact across your team
  • Develop and execute competitive strategies for your customers, positioning Databricks against incumbent and emerging platforms
  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams (DSAs, SSAs, Partners, Product) to deliver enterprise-grade solutions
  • Coach and develop junior SAs (L3–L5) on technical depth, customer engagement, and use case prioritisation
  • Contribute to Field Engineering thought leadership through customer-facing content, workshops, and community engagement

What We Look For

  • 8+ years in solutions architecture, principal engineering, technical pre-sales leadership, or a senior customer-facing technical role
  • Expert-level coding proficiency — Python, SQL, and ideally Spark/PySpark. You will complete a live coding assessment and a platform build during the interview
  • Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture: distributed systems at scale, streaming/real-time, lakehouse design patterns, data governance frameworks, and cloud-native platforms
  • Expert-level Databricks Platform knowledge (or equivalent depth in competing platforms with demonstrated rapid learning ability)
  • Declared technical specialisation with recognised depth — e.g., real-time architectures, ML/AI platforms, data governance, large-scale migrations, or industry-specific solutions
  • Proven track record of driving consumption growth and platform adoption in large accounts
  • Executive presence — ability to influence Directors, VPs, and C-level stakeholders on long-term data and AI strategy
  • Experience leading competitive displacements and complex enterprise evaluations
  • Strong strategic thinking — connecting technical architecture decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience); advanced degrees are valued

Nice to Have:

  • Databricks certifications
  • Prior experience at Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google, Microsoft, or a top-tier data/AI company
  • Published thought leadership (blogs, conference talks, open source contributions)

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Ability to defend architectural choices against real production workloads. Multi-Cloud & Kubernetes Fluency: Production experience with GCP and/or AWS, paired with solid understanding of trade-offs. Practical experience with Kubernetes (GKE or equivalent) as the runtime foundation for modern workloads. Infrastructure as Code: Strong proficiency in Terraform, GitOps workflows, and designing/reviewing reusable modules that other teams depend on. Data Architecture: Messaging platforms (Kafka/Confluent, Pub/Sub); database technology fluency across SQL (PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL), NoSQL (MongoDB), columnar analytics (Snowflake, BigQuery), and search (Solr, Elasticsearch); pipeline design (Dataflow, Cloud Composer, MSK, Kinesis); open table formats (Apache Iceberg). Comfortable shipping working prototypes rather than relying solely on high-level diagrams. Influence & Leadership: Strong technical leadership, writing, and presentation skills. Track record of driving standards adoption across engineering organizations without formal managerial authority—through documented rationale, prototypes, workshops, and review processes. Technology Evaluation: Demonstrated ability to run rigorous technology evaluations—separating vendor pitch from architectural fit, running POCs, and producing actionable recommendations for engineering leaders. AI Infrastructure Fluency: Working knowledge of the infrastructure demands of AI/ML workloads (model serving, vector databases, inference cost and latency trade-offs); able to weigh in on where AI fits into the platform’s technical roadmap. Bonus Points Depth in both Cloud Infrastructure and Data Infrastructure domains. Experience with GCP organization-level policies, folder structure, and IAM inheritance design. Confluent Platform knowledge beyond core Kafka (Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, ksqlDB). Experience running or participating in an Architecture Review Council or equivalent governance body. Hands-on experience building or applying AI-augmented architecture review workflows (e.g., MCP servers, LLM-based rubric evaluation). MLOps tooling experience (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines, SageMaker). Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

    Â

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

  1. Online assessment or practical task

Headquarters: Remote • Anywhere

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) 

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default 
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds 
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

We make a positive impact.

We aim for the stars.

We care for each other. 

Impact of a Billing Systems Architect

As an Enterprise Billing Systems Architect at Upsun, you are the technical anchor of our billing infrastructure, playing a vital role in ensuring our revenue operations, pricing structures, and financial integrations run seamlessly as our business scales. Picking up primary ownership from our implementation partner, you serve as the dedicated technical lead bridging Finance, Product, and Engineering.

You’re deeply analytical, systems-minded, and collaborative—someone who thrives on translating complex business, pricing, and accounting rules into reliable system logic. Working downstream from our core engineering and data mediation teams, you ensure the integrity of our Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) platform while continuously optimizing platform performance and automation.

Beyond day-to-day platform administration, you contribute to the long-term evolution of our billing architecture—supporting new pricing model launches, complex usage rating schemes, and financial system integrations. Your attention to detail, technical versatility, and cross-functional mindset ensure our revenue pipeline remains scalable, compliant, and friction-free.

What to expect

  • Billing Infrastructure & Administration: Serve as the hands-on technical owner of our BillingPlatform environment, configuring catalogs, price cards, usage rating rules, and automated invoice schedules.

  • System Operations & Maintenance: Own ongoing platform health, including system updates, pricing launches, recurring bill-run troubleshooting, sync exception handling, and root-cause issue resolution.

  • Data Ingestion & Analysis: Utilize SQL to perform data validation, rating engine auditing, and operational reporting while collaborating with Engineering to receive mediated usage data (e.g., via DigitalRoute or Kafka).

  • Integrations & API Management: Maintain and optimize clean, API-driven integrations connecting BillingPlatform to upstream CRMs (e.g. Salesforce), downstream ERP/GL tools (e.g., NetSuite), and payment gateways (e.g., Stripe).

  • Revenue Recognition Alignment: Partner closely with Accounting to ensure system rating rules, revenue schedules, and general ledger mappings satisfy ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance standards.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Gather technical and operational requirements directly from Accounting, Finance, Sales Ops, and Product teams, translating their vision into sustainable platform configuration.

  • Data Integrity & Migration: Maintain billing data continuity and manage subscription data updates or migrations without disrupting ongoing financial operations or revenue recognition flows.

What you bring

  • Q2C Platform Experience: Proven hands-on experience configuring and administering enterprise Quote-to-Cash or billing platforms (e.g., Zuora, Salesforce Revenue Cloud/CPQ, NetSuite Billing, Aria Systems, or BillingPlatform).

  • Data & Technical Skills: Strong proficiency with SQL for querying and auditing billing data, alongside a solid grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, and ETL workflows.

  • Modern Pricing Expertise: Experience supporting complex SaaS or infrastructure pricing models—such as PLG, hybrid commitment-plus-usage, tiered rates, and consumption-based/metered billing.

  • Revenue Recognition Knowledge: Practical understanding of rev rec fundamentals (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how accounting rules dictate billing engine design.

  • Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to bridge technical language and financial business logic, effectively collaborating with engineering teams and accounting stakeholders alike.

  • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: A methodical approach to diagnosing system sync errors, rating anomalies, and integration edge cases to ensure operational continuity.

 

Bonus points

  • Experience with DigitalRoute mediation software or Kafka event-stream data intake

  • Previous exposure to cloud infrastructure, PaaS, or developer-platform usage metrics

  • Background supporting system migrations from implementation partners into internal teams

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. 

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.   

You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Senior Director, FP&A and IT)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (Engineering team)
  4. 60 Minutes with Team (Finance team)
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

Flexible PTO

Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

Company stock options

Professional development budget

Office equipment budget

‍️ Wellness budget

Annual team gatherings

Internet reimbursement

Inclusive parental leave

️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. title: Social Comms
description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications—leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS). You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori. What we’re looking for: 5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model). Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance. Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations. Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations. Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects. Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations. Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP). Build upgrade-stable enhancements and side-by-side extensions, strictly minimizing legacy modifications to protect core system stability. Design and expose secure OData endpoints to power SAP Fiori user interfaces, mobile apps, and enterprise cloud integrations. Perform automated code checks (ATC), enforce clean code standards, conduct peer code reviews, and optimize legacy custom code for S/4HANA compatibility. Collaborate closely with SAP functional consultants, enterprise architects, and BTP specialists to translate business requirements into technical solution specifications.
